title: Verify Loop Mode Fix - No Wrong Line Flash
description: Comprehensive verification that loop mode no longer flashes to the wrong line. Must test multiple scenarios with actual browser interaction.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Start dev server if not running: bun run dev
Use mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate to go to http://localhost:3001/song/j972m34dzqgx6a0r5a00n9k6pd7zekfa
Wait for page to load, take screenshot of initial state
Click the 'Loop' mode button to enable loop mode
Take screenshot - verify Loop mode is selected
TEST 1 - Click line 5 (middle of song)
Take screenshot IMMEDIATELY after click - line 5 must be highlighted (NOT line 4)
Watch for 10+ seconds (3+ loop cycles)
Take screenshots during loop - line 5 must stay highlighted throughout
Verify: NO flash to line 4 at any point during the loops
TEST 2 - Click line 1 (first line boundary test)
Take screenshot - line 1 highlighted, no crash or weird behavior
Watch 2 loops - line 1 stays highlighted
TEST 3 - Click last line (end boundary test)
Take screenshot - last line highlighted
Watch 2 loops - last line stays highlighted
TEST 4 - Switch to Single mode, click line 10
Watch until line finishes - should advance to line 11 and pause
Verify: did NOT flash to line 9 at any point
TEST 5 - Switch to Fluid mode
Watch lines advance - each line highlights at correct time, no flashing to previous lines
Use mcp__browser-tools__getConsoleErrors - verify no JavaScript errors
Final screenshot showing successful playback
